Login / Register
About Us
Concept
A NEW ARTISTIC-CULTURAL LANDMARK AT WEST KOWLOON
D2 Place, the Cultural & Creativity Hub in West Kowloon, is the first Industrial Building Revitalization Project developed by Lawsgroup. Complete with 100,000 sq ft of retail space, 140,000 sq ft of commercial office space, the complex houses stylish fashion boutiques, creative markets, international F&B and lifestyle stores all under one roof. At D2 Place, we redefine the experience of shopping, dining and entertainment.
Featuring over 20,000 sqft. of event space and fascinating rooftop garden, D2 Place serves as a social hub to promote local culture and breed creativity.
Partner
FASHION FARM FOUNDATION
D2 Place strongly supports local creativity and serves as a platform to gather creative people and organizations which share the same passion for local culture and design. One of the sponsored entities is Fashion Farm Foundation (FFF) – an NGO founded by a group of enthusiastic entrepreneurs from the fashion and cultural creative industry – where its headquarters is located on the 9/F of D2 Place ONE with studios, co-working space and offices for individual designers.
We constantly collaborates with FFF on different events which support young local fashion designers to develop their own products, brand and business. Besides, the mall works closely with different organizers on various creative events and workshops.
Elevation
LAYOUT
A multifunctional complex comprising shops, showrooms, offices, studio workshops, specialty restaurant, sky garden and carparks, fulfils every desire of the turly discerning.

mall_info.parking:
D2 Place Parking
D2 Place Parking
Login / Register
D2 Place Parking
泊車優惠
Free Parking
基本泊車優惠
顧客於 D2 PLACE ONE、D2 PLACE TWO 或荔枝角道822號 指定商戶，以電子消費累積滿港幣 300 元或以上（最多 2 張不同商戶單據），可享 1 小時免費泊車；累積滿港幣 500 元或以上（最多 2 張不同商戶單據），可享 2 小時免費泊車；累積滿港幣 800 元或以上（最多 2 張不同商戶單據）及成為HAPI By D2 Place 會員，可享 3 小時免費泊車，如似類推。
Basic Parking:
Shoppers could enjoy 1 Hour of Free Parking for electronic spending of HK$300 or more, OR 2 Hours of Free Parking for electronic spending of HK$500 or more, HAPI Club by D2 Place member can extra enjoy 3 Hours of Free Parking for electronic spending of HK$800 or more and etc at designated merchants in D2 PLACE ONE, D2 PLACE TWO or the 822 Lai Chi Kok Road. The total spending amount could be accumulated by a maximum of 2 receipts.
多輛車輛泊車優惠
如顧客有多於一輛汽車需享有免費泊車優惠，由第二輛汽車起，每輛汽車須額外累積電子消費滿港幣 500 元或以上（最多 2 張單據，最多適用於六輛汽車），即可享 2 小時免費泊車。所有車輛必須同時辦理泊車優惠。
（例子：如顧客於週末有六輛汽車需享 2 小時免費泊車優惠，電子消費須累積滿港幣 3,000 元或以上（最多 2 張單據）。）
Multiple Vehicles:
If a shopper has more than one vehicle eligible for free parking, starting from the second vehicle, each additional vehicle must accumulate an additional electronic spending of HKD 500 or more (calculated based on a maximum of 2 receipts, up to six vehicles) to enjoy a 2-hour free parking benefit. All vehicles must also be registered for the parking promotion at the same time.
(Example: If a customer has six vehicles eligible for a 2-hour free parking on a weekend, the total electronic spending must reach HKD 3,000 or more, calculated based on a maximum of 2 receipts.)
條款及細則 Terms and Conditions:
換領者及簽賬者必須為同一人，商場職員有權要求出示相關證明作核對。
The person redeeming the parking discount and the person signing for it must be the same person. Mall staff have the right to request relevant proof for verification.
每張當日發票消費金額須為港幣 100 元或以上，以發票及相符電子貨幣存根之時間為準，逾期無效。
Each invoice must have a purchase amount of HK$100 or more on the same day, based on the date on the invoice and corresponding electronic payment stub. Invoices older than the specified date will be invalid.
每個車牌號碼每天只可兌換一次泊車優惠。
Each vehicle license plate number can only redeem the parking discount once per day.
D2 PLACE商戶及其職員不可享用此優惠。
Tenants and their staff at D2 PLACE are not eligible for this offer.
每張發票僅限兌換一次免費泊車優惠。如發現以同一套發票重複換領，顧客須補付相關泊車費用。
Each invoice can only be redeemed for one free parking discount. If the same invoice is found to be used for duplicate redemptions, the customer will be required to pay the corresponding parking fees.
不接受任何分拆簽賬，同一商戶之消費不可分拆成多張發票或簽賬存根以換領優惠，機印發票金額須與該次交易簽賬額相同。
Split receipts are not accepted. Purchases from the same merchant cannot be split into multiple invoices or receipts for redemption. The amount on the machine-printed invoice must be the same as the amount on the receipt for that transaction.
指定商戶不包括市集、POP-UP Stores 或其他商場推廣活動之消費。
Designated merchants do not include purchases made at markets, pop-up stores, or other mall promotional activities.
不接受現金付款發票、手寫單據、發票影印本、購買或增值八達通、財務還款、公共事業費用、臨時展銷攤位（詳情請參閱 D2 Place 官方網站）、零售小賣車、購買或使用禮券、商戶現金券、商場贈券、電子贈券、鞋券、湯券、飲品券、食品券等非零售性消費。
Cash payments, invoices, handwritten receipts, photocopies of invoices, purchases or top-ups of Octopus cards, bank transfers, utility bill payments, temporary sales booths (see the D2 Place official website for details), retail carts, purchases or use of gift certificates, merchant cash vouchers, mall vouchers, e-vouchers, shoe vouchers, soup vouchers, beverage vouchers, food vouchers, and other non-retail purchases are not accepted.
泊車優惠適用於 D2 Place ONE、D2 Place TWO 及荔枝角道 822 號停車場。
Free Parking only apply to D2 Place ONE, D2 Place TWO, and the 822 Lai Chi Kok Road car park.
顧客須於一期、二期商場或荔枝角道 822 號地面泊車收費站登記。所有參與免費泊車優惠的車輛須於免費時數內離開停車場，超出時段將按正常收費計算。
Customers must register at the D2 Place ONE, TWO or the G/F parking payment area at 822 Lai Chi Kok Road. All vehicles participating in the free parking discount must leave the car park within the free time period; vehicles exceeding the free time will be charged at the normal rate.
優惠只接受 D2 Place 一期或二期商戶發出之即日機印發票，並附有商戶名稱、購買日期及金額，以及相符之電子貨幣付款存根（包括信用卡/易辦事/八達通/銀聯卡/Apple Pay/Android Pay/Samsung Pay/微信支付/支付寶，或其他受《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》規管的儲值支付工具）。發票只計算實際簽賬金額，使用優惠碼、現金券或其他形式之優惠支付部分或全部貨款將不予計算。不接受單據影印本、複印本、損毀或塗改之單據、手寫單據及信用咭收據存根等。
This offer is only valid for same-day machine-printed invoices issued by merchants in D2 Place Phase 1 or 2, bearing the merchant's name, purchase date, amount, and a matching electronic payment stub (including credit cards/EasyPay/Octopus/UnionPay/Apple Pay/Android Pay/Samsung Pay/WeChat Pay/Alipay, or other stored-value payment instruments regulated by the Payment Systems and Stored Value Instruments Ordinance). Only the actual amount paid will be counted; payments made using promo codes, vouchers, or other forms of discounts will not be counted. Photocopies, copies, damaged or altered documents, handwritten documents, and credit card receipts are not accepted.
此優惠只適用於私家車及客貨車。
This offer is only applicable to private cars and vans.
已用作換領泊車優惠之單據，仍可參與其他商場推廣活動。
Receipts already used for parking discounts can still be used for other mall promotions.
D2 PLACE保留隨時更改優惠條款及細則之權利，如有任何爭議，D2 PLACE保留最終決定權。
D2 PLACE reserves the rights to alter or amend the terms and conditions at any time without prior notice. In case of any dispute, the decision by D2 PLACE shall be final.

Leasing And Renting
FOR SHOPS
UNIQUE MALL EXPERIENCE
D2 Place locates at the Kowloon west transportation hub, next to Lai Chi Kok MTR Exit D2 which is highly accessible, with parking spaces available for your added convenience. The five-storey mall provides customers with one-stop dining, shopping and enjoyment of life.  Adding the charm, the rooftop garden offers a comfortable and beautiful outdoor environment, exposure to different view of Lai Chi Kok.
Leasing Department
Tel: 2371 1999
E-mail: leasing@d2place.com
FOR VENUES
EXHIBITION & EVENT VENUES
The promotion and exhibition venues are composed of lightings, sound equipments and other facilities , ideal for corporate events, fashion show, product launches, workshops, markets, fashion show, themed parties, photo shoots and more.

FOR POP-UP STORES
‘Dream it. Do it’
Pop-up Store Anniversary Campaign
High rent has turned most shopping malls in Hong Kong into a cookie-cutter and forced small and individual business operators to either shut down or relocate to suburban areas. In contrary, D2 Place strives to promote local culture through organizing regular creative events, and in 2016, we has successfully launched a Pop-up Store campaign “Dream It, Do It”which received over 100 applications and more than 20 local brands have started their first business here. To celebrate its anniversary, we are now offering a brand new pop-up store campaign for all entrepreneurs and local handcrafters.
Short-term Lease x Flexible Terms x Local Brands
“Dream It, Do It! Anniversary Campaign" offers a total of 15 Pop-up Store spaces, located along high traffic pathways within D2 Place ONE and D2 Place TWO. To differentiate from other in-mall tenants, D2 Pop-up Stores will be only applicable to Local Brands on short-term lease of 1 to 3 months. In addition to flexible terms and rental offers, D2 Place will also provide a list of furniture for shop owners to choose from for an easy startup.
In just less-than-a-year time, the Pop-up Store campaign received over 100 applications and is highly welcomed by the local creative industries and young entrepreneurs. 6 of those brands have become our valuable shop tenants from the Pop-up Stores campaign, including:
「Jennymadrose」－selling own-formulated handmade skincare & lifestyle products;
「Lisa & Sara」－selling own-formulated perfume, aroma diffuser and handmade soap;
「Jasoo 자수」－selling Korean style handmade gemstone & simple accessories;
「Fábula Select Shop」－offering handmade leather products, customization service and DIY workshops;
「Curate」－selling designer fashion items & accessories;
「Lost n Found 811」－featuring a wide collection of designer fashion items & lifestyle products.
Pop-up Store Campaign Details
• 15 Pop-up Stores open for application
• Short-term lease for 1 - 3 months only
• D2 Place ONE (1/F - 4/F) and D2 Place TWO (1/F)
• Free provision of basic furniture & display accessories
• Promotion & other operation supports
• Special Rental Offers
Leasing Department
Tel: 2371 1999
E-mail:
leasing@d2place.com
FOR BOOTHS
"D2 Place Weekend Markets" regularly organizes a variety of local markets, aiming to promote local culture and encourage young people to develop their own business. With the mission of "Small Shops with Big Ideas", D2 Place strived to create a new and ideal destination for everyone to spend their weekends.  We are welcome for any handcrafters, designers or artiste joining our big party!
Marketing Department
